grounding: decisions/0006-retention-clock-and-operations.md: Retention cutoff (raw replay removed when its first fragment is before today - 14 days) and Saved replays (exempt, counts against the 25 GiB cap, 5 GiB sub-cap, saved_replay_budget_exceeded)
decisions/0006-retention-clock-and-operations.md: Application clock (cases use the test clock)
format: The replay chunk format stays with milestone 09. Captures here are opaque byte counts; any format can store them.
